We need to answer: "What type of engine powered both the Saab 36 and the Avro Vulcan?" Use evidence.

From Saab 36 evidence: sentence 3: "The engine was to be a version of the British Bristol Olympus turbojet, the same engine powering the Avro Vulcan jet bomber."

Thus engine type: British Bristol Olympus turbojet.

We need citations: from Saab 36 sentence 3 (title "Saab 36", sentence_id 3). Also maybe from Avro Vulcan evidence? Not needed but could cite that Avro Vulcan used Bristol Olympus. However not in given evidence. The Avro Vulcan description does not mention engine type. So we rely on Saab 36 sentence that says same engine powering Avro Vulcan. That is sufficient.

Thus answer: "the British Bristol Olympus turbojet". Provide JSON with answer and citations list.

Citations format: [document title, zero-based sentence index]. So ["Saab 36", 3].
